title: Proposed: Jev as an optional tool (ADR-015)
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: A proposed decision record on TypeSafe AI's fast structured-decision model, Jev. It may score replays after the fact, guard LLM-written content and play a slow "strategist" opponent in headless matches, but never inside the 60 Hz tick. Every answer is logged with the match, so replays and CI never call the service. Its output is never a training source for imitation or distillation, which its contract forbids. The arena and Saltmarsh keep running with no API key, and nothing is added until Nye approves.
next: Nye's call on the scope, the company account and the open questions.
